units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant may not carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. Upon receiving an instruction from the relevant manager that the municipal servant considers unlawful, the municipal servant must provide the manager who gave it with a written explanation of its unlawfulness, identifying the provisions of federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow, and municipal legal acts that could be violated by carrying out the instruction. If the manager confirms the instruction in writing, the municipal servant must refuse to carry it out. If an unlawful instruction is carried out, the municipal servant and the manager who gave it are liable under federal legislation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) determines the procedure for notifying them of instances in which any person approaches a municipal servant with the aim of inducing them to commit corruption offences, the information to be included in such notifications, the arrangements for verifying that information, and the procedure for registering notifications.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1. A citizen may not be admitted to municipal service, and a municipal servant may not remain in municipal service, in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 2) being sentenced to a punishment that precludes performance of the official duties of a municipal service position, or being deprived for a specified period of the right to hold municipal service positions, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining clearance to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws, if the duties of the municipal service position for which the citizen is applying or which the municipal servant holds involve the use of such information;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 4) having an illness that prevents entry into or performance of municipal service, confirmed by an opinion of a medical organization. The procedure for preventive medical examinations, the list of such illnesses and the form of the medical organization’s opinion are established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 5) close family relationship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, as well as a spouse’s brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with the head of a municipal entity who heads the administration, where holding the municipal service position entails direct subordination or accountability to that official, or with a municipal servant where holding the position entails direct subordination or accountability of one of them to the other;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 7) holding citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state, or a residence permit or another document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 8) submission, upon entry into municipal service and/or during its performance, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information confirming compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements the violation of which precludes holding a municipal service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information demonstrating noncompliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements the violation of which precludes holding a municipal service position;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 9) failing to submit information required by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 “On Combating Corruption”, other federal laws and this Law, or submitting knowingly inaccurate or incomplete information when entering municipal service;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 9.1) being found, in accordance with the conclusion of a conscription commission, not to have performed military service by conscription without lawful grounds (except citizens who have performed military service under a contract): for 10 years from the expiry of the period allowed for appealing that conclusion to the conscription commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation; or, if that conclusion and/or the decision of that constituent entity’s conscription commission on the citizen’s appeal against the conclusion was challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of the court decision finding that the citizen’s rights were not violated when the conclusion and/or the decision of the constituent entity’s conscription commission on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was issued;
units.label: Point 9.1 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 10) other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1.1. A citizen may not be appointed as head of administration under a contract, and a municipal servant may not hold that position under a contract, where they have a close family relationship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, as well as a spouse’s brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with the head of the municipal entity.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1.2. A citizen may not be appointed as chairperson or deputy chairperson of a municipal entity’s control and audit body, and a municipal servant may not hold either position, where they have a close family relationship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, as well as a spouse’s brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with the Chairperson of the representative body, the head of the municipal entity, the head of administration, or the heads of judicial and law-enforcement bodies located in the territory of the relevant municipal entity.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 2. The maximum age for holding a municipal service position is 65 years. A citizen may not be admitted to municipal service after reaching that age. The employer’s representative (employer) may extend the service of a municipal servant who has reached the maximum age for holding a municipal service position once, by no more than one year.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
units.text: 3. To avoid a conflict of interest, a municipal servant who is the head or deputy head of a local self-government body may not represent municipal servants’ interests in that body’s elected trade union body while holding the relevant position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1. In connection with municipal service, a municipal servant is prohibited from:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1) repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 23 of 13.05.2015;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 2) holding a municipal service position in the event of:
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: а) election or appointment to a state office of the Russian Federation, the City of Moscow or another constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or appointment to a position in state service;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: б) election or appointment to a municipal office in the City of Moscow or another constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: в) election to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 3) participate in managing a commercial or non-commercial organization, except in the cases provided for by point 3 of part 1 of Article 14 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 3.1) engage in entrepreneurial activity personally or through proxies;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 4) acting as an agent or representative in third-party matters before the local self-government body in which they hold a municipal service position or which is directly subordinate or accountable to them, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 5) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with official status or the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary remuneration, loans, services, payment for entertainment, holidays or transport expenses, or other rewards). Gifts received by a municipal servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips or other official events are recognized as municipal property and are transferred by the municipal servant under a transfer record to the local self-government body in which the servant holds a municipal service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A municipal servant who has surrendered a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 6) undertaking business trips funded by individuals or legal entities, except business trips undertaken on a reciprocal basis by agreement between the local self-government body and local self-government bodies of other municipalities, or with state authorities and local self-government bodies of foreign states or international and foreign nonprofit organizations;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 7) using material, technical, financial or other support resources, or other municipal property, for purposes unrelated to the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 8) disclosing, or using for purposes unrelated to municipal service, information classified as confidential under federal laws, or official information, learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 9) make public statements, judgments or assessments, including in the media, concerning the activities of local self-government bodies or their heads, where this is not part of their official duties;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 10) accepting, without the written permission of the head of the municipality, awards or honorary or special titles (other than academic titles) from foreign states, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if interaction with those organizations or associations forms part of the servant’s official duties;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 11) using the advantages of official status for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 12) using official status in the interests of political parties, religious associations or other public associations, or publicly expressing attitudes toward those associations in the capacity of a municipal servant;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 13) establish structures of political parties, religious associations or other public associations within local self-government bodies (except trade unions, veterans’ bodies and other bodies of public self-organization), or facilitate the establishment of such structures;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 14) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of resolving a labor dispute;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 15) serving on governing bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 16) engage, without written permission from the employer’s representative (employer), in paid activity financed exclusively from the resources of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens and stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation.
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 1.1. To obtain permission from the employer’s representative (employer) to participate without remuneration in the management of a non-commercial organization in cases where such permission is required under point 3 of part 1 of Article 14 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, a municipal servant submits a written application for such permission to the employer’s representative (employer), together with copies of the constituent documents of the non-commercial organization concerned. Within no more than 10 working days after receiving the application, the employer’s representative (employer) considers it and decides either to permit the municipal servant to participate in the management of the non-commercial organization or to refuse permission if such participation could give rise to a conflict of interest. Within three working days of that decision, the employer’s representative (employer) informs the municipal servant of it in writing, against signature. The procedure for considering the application by the employer’s representative (employer) is established by the representative body.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 2. A municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under a contract may not engage in other paid activity, except teaching, scientific and other creative activity. Such teaching, scientific and other creative activity may not be financed exclusively from the resources of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens and stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 2.1. Repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 7 of 04.04.2012.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 2.2. A municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under a contract is prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash or valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, and owning and/or using foreign financial instruments.
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 3. After leaving municipal service, a citizen is not entitled to disclose, or use in the interests of organizations or individuals, confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
units.text: 4. For two years after leaving municipal service, a citizen who held a municipal service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts may not hold a position in an organization under an employment agreement and/or perform work for that organization under a civil-law contract in the cases provided for by federal laws, where their official (service) duties included certain functions of municipal (administrative) management of that organization, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of municipal servants and settlement of conflicts of interest (hereinafter, the conflict-of-interest settlement commission). Such consent is given in the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.label: Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 1. For the purposes of this Law, the terms “conflict of interest” and “personal interest” established by Article 10 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption” are used.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 2. Repealed. — Law of the City of Moscow of 27.01.2016 No. 5.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 2.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist of changing the official or service position of a municipal servant who is a party to the conflict, up to suspension from the performance of official (service) duties according to the established procedure, and/or the servant’s renunciation of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 2.2. If a person holding a municipal service position owns securities (participatory interests or units in the authorised (contributed) capital of organisations), and this leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, that person must transfer their securities (participatory interests or units in the authorised (contributed) capital of organisations) into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 2.3. Failure by a municipal servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it constitutes an offense resulting in dismissal from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2.3 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 3. An employer’s representative (employer) who becomes aware that a municipal servant has a personal interest which leads or may lead to a conflict of interest must take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest, up to and including suspension of the municipal servant who is a party to the conflict of interest from the municipal service position held, in the procedure established by this Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 3.1. Failure by a municipal servant acting as an employer’s representative (employer), who has become aware that a subordinate municipal servant has a personal interest which leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, to take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest constitutes an offence entailing dismissal from municipal service of the municipal servant acting as the employer’s representative (employer), except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 4. To ensure municipal servants’ compliance with the general principles of official conduct and to resolve conflicts of interest, a commission for resolving conflicts of interest is established in the local self-government body in the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 5. The commission for resolving conflicts of interest is established by a municipal legal act. Its membership includes the employer’s representative (employer) and/or municipal servants authorised by that representative (including those from the structural unit in which the municipal servant who is a party to the conflict of interest holds a municipal service position), as well as representatives of scientific and educational organisations and other organisations invited by the employer’s representative (employer) as independent experts specialising in issues related to municipal service, without specifying the experts’ personal data. Independent experts must make up at least one quarter of the total membership of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
units.text: 6. The regulations on the commission for resolving conflicts of interest are approved by the representative body.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and to a high professional standard;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 2) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals, legal entities and organizations, give no preference to any public or religious associations, professional or social groups, citizens or organizations, and avoid bias toward such associations, groups, organizations and citizens;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 3) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that hinder conscientious performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 16.1

units.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
units.text: 4) maintain neutrality so as to exclude the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public or religious associations or other organizations influence their professional official activities;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 16.1
